deviceMode.joinTitle: Join a host as a device
deviceMode.joinHint: Work on another laptop's tournament over the tab-room network. Ask the host for its address and an 8-digit code from its Devices page. You only see and change what your role allows; the host keeps the tournament.
deviceMode.stateWaiting: Waiting for the host to approve. Check that the host's screen shows these six words in this order.
deviceMode.wordsLabel: Words to compare with the host
deviceMode.wordsHint: If the words differ, tell the host to reject this laptop: someone may be in the middle.
deviceMode.connection.reconnecting: Connection lost. Reconnecting; you can keep working.
deviceMode.queued: {count, plural, one {# change is} other {# changes are}} waiting to be sent to the host.
deviceMode.rejectedTitle: The host did not accept {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} made while offline:
deviceMode.leaveConfirm: Leave the host? This laptop's copy of the tournament and its pairing are deleted; changes not yet sent are lost.
promote.title: Promote this laptop to host
promote.copyState: This laptop's full copy holds every change up to number {seq}.
promote.noCopy: This laptop has no full copy yet. It receives one while connected to the host.
promote.rank: It is number {rank} in the succession list.
promote.betterRanked: Laptops ranked above this one: {names}. If one of them is working, promote that one instead.
promote.folderLabel: Folder for the new host's tournament file
promote.newerCopyLabel: Newer copy from another tab director (optional)
promote.newerCopyHint: If another tab director's laptop stayed connected longer, save its copy there and choose the file here. SimpleTab uses whichever copy is newer, and refuses copies that disagree.
promote.hostReachable: The host is reachable, so this laptop cannot be promoted. Promotion is only for when the host laptop is gone.
promote.saveCopy: Save this laptop's copy to the folder
promote.confirm: Promote this laptop to host? It becomes the new host with a higher host number. Every other laptop must pair with it again, and the old host stops accepting changes once it learns about the new one.
promote.replacedBody: Another laptop was promoted to host, so this tournament is now read-only here. Pair this laptop with the new host as a device to keep working.
promote.replacedFile: Changes made here after the handover were saved for review in {file}.
